title: Race cancels against submits on the TBS layer
preconditions: a per-prefix virtual TPM is running under the M10-048 manager
steps: issue a storm of cancels on one context, then submit again
run a submit-loop process and a cancel-loop process against the same live prefix concurrently
cancel on a context whose virtual TPM has since stopped
invariants: invariant 23: Every untrusted parser has fixed limits for total bytes, nesting, fields, strings, collections, and processing time.
invariant 40: Unsupported, revoked, unavailable, transient, and policy-denied outcomes remain distinguishable.
residual_risk: swtpm cannot interrupt a synchronous in-flight command, so cancel is compatibility surface bounded to what the virtual TPM reports; a dead virtual TPM yields IOERROR, never a hang; executable evidence: wine/tests/test-tbs-attacks.py cancellation family
